decisions.summary: I checked the Brazil presidential election polls, NFL injury reports for Sunday's games, and the US-Iran ceasefire status. The Commanders are missing QB Jayden Daniels, their starting RB and a starting guard against the Colts, but that news broke two days ago and sportsbook lines (Colts -205) already match Polymarket's price almost exactly, so there is no edge left there. Brazil election prices are close to what other prediction markets and recent polls imply, and the gap was too small once fees are included. No outcome cleared the 5 percentage point edge bar after fees, so I am holding all cash this cycle with zero trades.
